content: A cinematic dark landing page mockup for a Japanese-inspired creative agency called {argument name="studio name" default="AKAI STUDIO"}, shown inside a modern desktop browser window. The page uses a dramatic black-to-deep-red gradient background with a moody sunset glow, scattered small white dust or ash particles, and a widescreen hero layout. On the right side, place a full-body samurai seen from behind, standing on jagged black rocks near a calm shoreline, wearing dark layered armor and a horned helmet, holding a katana at his side, with a long torn crimson cape blowing strongly to the right. On the left side, create bold oversized white condensed sans-serif headline text in Spanish reading {argument name="headline text" default="DISEÑO BRUTAL"}, split across two stacked lines. Above it, add a small eyebrow line with a tiny red vertical accent: {argument name="eyebrow text" default="DISEÑO QUE DEJA HUELLA"}. Below the headline, add large Japanese characters followed by STUDIO: {argument name="subheadline text" default="赤い侍 STUDIO"}. Beneath that, place a short supporting paragraph in small uppercase white text: {argument name="body text" default="BRANDING, WEB DESIGN Y EXPERIENCIAS DIGITALES PARA MARCAS QUE QUIEREN DESTACAR."}. Add two call-to-action buttons below the copy: a filled light button labeled "VER PROYECTOS" and an outlined dark button labeled "CONTACTAR". Across the top navigation bar, include exactly 4 centered menu items in uppercase: "INICIO", "SERVICIOS", "PROYECTOS", "CONTACTO", with "INICIO" marked as active using a small red underline. Put a boxed top-right button labeled {argument name="top button text" default="HABLEMOS"}. In the top-left of the site header, add a logo block with a small red square containing the kanji "赤", the brand name "AKAI STUDIO", and a tiny Japanese subtitle beneath it. The overall style should feel like high-end brutalist web design meets cinematic game key art: ultra-polished UI mockup, sharp typography, strong contrast, luxury agency aesthetic, minimal but powerful composition, black, white, and crimson palette, subtle grain, realistic lighting, premium presentation.

Using the provided reference image as the brand inspiration, transform the fried chicken burger and waffle fries meal into a polished one-page logo guidelines board for a restaurant brand named {argument name="brand name" default="Can Dende"}. Create a cheerful, modern fast-casual identity derived from the food in the reference: turn the crispy fried topping into a playful mascot/icon above the wordmark, and build a bold custom logo in a warm palette inspired by the photo. Design the output as a clean editorial brand sheet on an off-white background with navy and red typography, yellow scalloped borders at the top and bottom, and small sparkle doodles. Include these exact sections and counts: 1 main header reading "LOGO GUIDELINES" with the brand name beneath it; 1 "PRIMARY LOGO" section with the main logo and an "ABOUT THE LOGO" text block; 1 "LOGO VARIANTS" section with 3 variants labeled "FULL COLOR", "SINGLE COLOR", and "REVERSED"; 1 "COLOR VARIATIONS" section with 4 tiles labeled "YELLOW BACKGROUND", "NAVY BACKGROUND", "PINK BACKGROUND", and "NAVY ON CREAM"; 1 "MINIMUM SIZE" section showing the logo with a width guide and the text "1.25 in / 120 px MINIMUM WIDTH"; 1 "CLEAR SPACE" section with a spacing diagram based on the height of the letter C; 1 "INCORRECT USAGE" section with 4 wrong examples labeled "Don't change the colors", "Don't stretch or distort", "Don't rotate the logo", and "Don't add effects or shadows"; 1 "USAGE NOTES" section with 4 bullet points; and a handwritten-style closing tagline at bottom right that says {argument name="tagline text" default="It's a vibe. It's a smile. It's yours."}. Keep the composition crisp, print-ready, highly legible, and presentation-quality, like a real branding deliverable for a restaurant.

Using REFERENCE_0 as the hero food photo, transform it into a polished one-page restaurant branding board for a fried chicken and waffle-fries concept named {argument name="brand name" default="Can Dende"}. Keep the yellow-table food photography as the visual anchor, but redesign the output as a clean square brand guideline sheet on a warm off-white background with a cheerful, retro, hand-drawn fast-casual identity. Add a large logo area in the upper left with bold vintage red lettering, a small illustrated fried-food mascot above it, and the tagline “FRIED CHICKEN & RUFFLES”. Build the page as a structured multi-panel layout with 9 sections: 1) logo/hero area, 2) brand story text block, 3) top-right hero photo crop from the reference, 4) color palette showing exactly 5 swatches with hex labels, 5) typography section with a large display sample of the brand name plus 3 text styles labeled header, subhead, and body, 6) patterns and textures section with exactly 4 playful assets: a yellow wavy stripe pattern, a red checker pattern, a handwritten phrase, and a small doodle heart, 7) iconography section with exactly 5 simple icons: chicken, bottle, fries, smiley face, and heart, 8) photography style section with a 2x2 grid of exactly 4 food-photo crops derived from the reference and matching close-up shots, plus a short bullet list of photography guidelines, and 9) brand applications section with exactly 5 mockups labeled signage, takeout packaging, menu design, social media, and staff apparel. Include a circular badge near the hero photo that says {argument name="badge text" default="CRISPY GOOD MOOD"}. Use the palette {argument name="primary palette" default="yellow, tomato red, deep navy, leaf green, soft pink"}. Add a bottom banner with 2 sections titled “VOICE & VIBE” and a short brand summary paragraph. Overall feel: modern branding presentation, vibrant, appetizing, playful, sunny, editorial, highly legible, premium-but-fun.

A photorealistic macOS desktop screenshot of a machine learning engineer’s workspace at night, shown straight-on with a dark blue macOS menu bar and the dock visible along the bottom. The desktop contains exactly 2 main application windows side by side. On the left, a large Visual Studio Code window in dark theme occupies about two-thirds of the screen. The VS Code project is named "VISIONCLASSIFIER" in the Explorer sidebar, with a realistic Python ML folder tree including exactly 11 visible top-level or expanded items: .venv, data, raw, processed, images, notebooks, src, utils, config.yaml, requirements.txt, README.md. Inside notebooks, show exactly 2 visible files: 01_data_exploration.ipynb and 02_model_training.ipynb. Inside src, show a realistic ML code structure with dataset.py, transforms.py, models, resnet.py, train, engine.py, trainer.py, utils.py. The editor area has exactly 4 tabs open: trainer.py, engine.py, resnet.py, config.yaml. The active tab is trainer.py. Display clean, believable Python training code for a ResNet image classification pipeline, including a class Trainer, methods train(self) and train_epoch(self, epoch: int) -> Dict[str, float], references to self.cfg.training.epochs, train_metrics, val_metrics, scheduler.step, save_checkpoint, self.model.train(), batch["image"], batch["label"], optimizer.zero_grad, criterion, loss.backward, optimizer.step, accuracy(outputs, targets, topk=(1,))[0]. Make the code sharp but naturally screen-like, with line numbers visible around lines 24 to 52. At the bottom of the VS Code window, the integrated terminal is open on the TERMINAL tab and shows realistic training logs for exactly 4 epochs in view: Epoch 12/50, Epoch 13/50, Epoch 14/50, Epoch 15/50, each with train and val lines listing Loss, Acc@1, and Acc@5, plus a final line saying a new best checkpoint was saved. Keep the numbers plausible for a successful training run, with top-1 accuracy around 0.88 to 0.91 and top-5 around 0.97 to 0.98. Include the usual VS Code status bar along the bottom with Python environment details. On the right, place exactly 1 dark-themed web browser window showing a local dashboard at localhost:8000 with the page title "VisionClassifier | Dashboard" and the app header "VisionClassifier" plus subtitle "Image Classification Model". The dashboard contains exactly 3 stacked sections. The first section is "Model Overview" with exactly 4 metric cards: Top-1 Accuracy 91.23%, Top-5 Accuracy 98.30%, Total Parameters 23.51M, Model ResNet-50. The second section is "Recent Training" with a dark line chart of accuracy over 50 epochs, showing exactly 2 colored curves labeled Train (Top-1) and Val (Top-1), both rising quickly and stabilizing around the low 90s. The third section is "Confusion Matrix" showing a 10x10 heatmap with a bright diagonal and axes labeled True Label and Predicted Label. Use subtle reflections, crisp typography, realistic UI spacing, and believable screen glow. The macOS top menu bar should show common menus like Code, File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Window, Help on the left and system icons with the time reading Tue May 13 9:41 AM on the right. The dock should contain many recognizable app icons and feel authentic but not distracting. Overall style: ultra-realistic screenshot, professional developer workstation, polished dark mode interfaces, no stylization, no illustration, indistinguishable from a real screen capture.

A dark gothic fantasy scene inside a vast abandoned cathedral, vertical full-body composition. In the exact center stands a mysterious sorceress in an elegant Victorian-inspired black gown with a fitted corset bodice, intricate silver embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, long draping lace panels from the arms, black gloves, and a long trailing skirt. Her hair is styled in a neat dark updo with a subtle ornamental hairpiece, and she wears delicate jewelry. She holds an open spellbook in one hand and raises the other hand in a poised spellcasting gesture. Surround her with low-lying mist and curling smoke. The cathedral interior is immense and decayed, with towering pointed arches, ribbed vaulted ceilings, cracked stone floors, broken tombs or altars on both sides, and thick twisted roots spreading across the ground and wrapping around the stone structures. Place exactly 2 large gargoyle statues perched symmetrically on elevated side structures, one on the left and one on the right, looming over the scene. Add many black candles with warm orange flames scattered across the foreground and midground, creating ritual ambience. In the background, show tall stained-glass windows with cold bluish daylight streaming through them in dramatic god rays, contrasting with the candlelight. Mood is haunting, arcane, cinematic, solemn, and highly detailed, with realistic textures, deep shadows, volumetric lighting, atmospheric haze, dark blue-gray color palette, and ultra-detailed gothic architecture.

A cinematic dark fantasy scene inside a vast gothic cathedral at night, centered on a mysterious woman in a floor-length black ceremonial gown standing in the middle of a glowing occult circle. The composition is perfectly symmetrical and frontal, with the woman placed dead center beneath a huge rose window and a bright full moon visible through the stained glass. She wears an ornate, form-fitting {argument name="dress color" default="black"} gown with lace, embroidered filigree, semi-sheer sleeves, a corseted bodice, and a long flowing train spreading across the stone floor. Her pose is regal and ritualistic, arms slightly extended at her sides with open hands, as if summoning smoke or dark magic. Her face is obscured and indistinct, with dark updo hair and a high gothic collar or headpiece. Around her feet is a large circular sigil inscribed in glowing {argument name="sigil glow color" default="amber-gold"} lines, with intricate symbols and concentric rings. Place exactly 30 black candles of varying heights around the circle and foreground, all lit, with warm flames casting low orange highlights. Fill the air with drifting smoke and mist, especially around her hands, the lower floor, and the side aisles. The cathedral interior is towering, shadowy, and highly detailed, with ribbed vaults, pointed arches, weathered stone, elaborate carvings, and deep blue-black darkness. On the left and right sides, include exactly 2 massive gargoyle or demon statues perched on ornate pedestals, one per side, leaning inward protectively or menacingly. Behind the woman, a raised altar and clusters of additional candles recede into darkness. Lighting is moody and high-contrast, dominated by cold moonlight from above and warm candlelight from below, creating metallic highlights on the dress and architecture. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, dramatic volumetric fog, gothic horror atmosphere, occult elegance, epic scale, sharp textures, realistic shadows, and a haunting, majestic mood.

Her hair and outfit are decorated with scattered small blossoms, and the background is filled with floating flowers, petals, tiny hearts, and faint ribbon-like swirls for a soft spring fantasy atmosphere. Create a luxurious Japanese magazine-style PR editorial spread for a publishing and branding service, designed as a two-page brochure layout. The left half is a dark, cinematic portrait scene in a sophisticated office lounge: a seated Japanese businessman in a navy bespoke suit, white shirt, dark tie, white pocket square, and wristwatch sits in a leather chair with one hand near his chin, posed thoughtfully beside a glossy wooden table. His face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. The lighting is moody and warm, with reflections from tall windows and a premium executive atmosphere. On this dark left page, place large elegant serif headline text in English reading {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}, stacked in two lines near the upper left in muted gold. Below it, add multiple lines of Japanese copy in white, including a larger subheadline and several short body paragraphs arranged vertically. Near the lower left, include a bordered dark box containing exactly 4 checklist items, each preceded by a check mark, with Japanese text. Put a small page number "02" in the bottom-left corner. The right half is a clean white editorial information page with refined minimalist typography and generous spacing. At the top, place a large Japanese headline in black, aligned upper center-right, with two short Japanese body text blocks beneath it; on the upper far right include a small photo of exactly 4 stacked hardcover books and a glass vase near a bright window with greenery. Across the middle, add a centered section title in Japanese for five benefits, followed by exactly 5 numbered columns labeled 1 through 5, each with a short Japanese heading and several lines of smaller explanatory Japanese text. Beneath that, add another centered Japanese section title for workflow, followed by exactly 4 step blocks laid out horizontally: STEP 01 with a speech bubble icon, STEP 02 with a pencil icon, STEP 03 with an open book icon, STEP 04 with a megaphone icon. Each step includes the English word STEP plus a two-digit number, a short Japanese subtitle, and a few lines of smaller Japanese description, with small chevrons between steps. Along the bottom of the right page, place exactly 3 rectangular photos side by side: a city-view office meeting table scene, a close-up of a hand writing with a pen, and a stack of books near an open book. Under these images, add a prominent Japanese closing statement in a serif style on the lower left, and a smaller Japanese paragraph on the lower right. Put page number "03" in the bottom-right corner. Use a premium palette of deep navy, black, warm brown, ivory, and muted gold, with a balance of editorial luxury, corporate trust, and high-end publishing aesthetics. The overall composition should feel like a real magazine advertisement or consulting brochure, polished, photorealistic, elegant, and credible.

Use soft painterly watercolor textures, delicate linework, airy lighting, gentle depth of field, and a luminous pastel palette dominated by sky blue, white, and yellow.
